_note: The FUSED half of the noise floor (LEDGER §4.7, §4.4 gap list).
_operator_note: FROZEN, not re-fitted per arm: re-selecting would measure the floor of a fitting procedure, a different and much larger quantity (LEDGER 7).
_components_note: the two held-out dev slices carry pool row indices rather than document text, so BM25 -- and therefore any fused read -- does not exist for them by construction.
bar_formula: bar = max(0.0040, 2 x floor); floor = max pairwise |delta| over the arms naming the null

row.title: noise-floor measurement (the instrument every bar is set against)
row.question: How large is a difference this dev instrument produces from nothing at all?
row.endpoint: group_vector_median, worst_group, out_of_domain_macro and all_component_macro on the full pinned dev suite, int8, through the released QueryTable path
row.comparator: K=3 arms of the IDENTICAL recipe, identical data, identical B checkpoint, differing ONLY in training seed (a true null)
row.bar: no bar: this measures the instrument and adopts nothing. It EMITS bars: floor(endpoint) = max of the 3 pairwise |delta|; bar(endpoint) = max(0.0040, 2 x floor(endpoint)).
row.no_survivor: not applicable -- a floor always exists. If the floor exceeds the planning minimum on an endpoint, every bar reading that endpoint rises accordingly and that is the finding.
row.also_published: the +/-10% A-steps arms, as RECIPE SENSITIVITY beside the floor, never as the floor: a step change is a treatment, not a null
row.frame_disclosure: measured in the incumbent teacher frame and the M7 data mix, A leg only with the B checkpoint fixed. An arm differing in its B leg has a larger floor and no bar may read such an arm until that floor is measured too.
